= false group by gmd.group_id ), group_loan_agg as ( select group_id, SUM(loan_amount) as amt_financed, MIN(expected_disbursement_date) as expected_disbursement_date, MAX(term) as tenure, acs.past_due_days_to group by bal.group_id ) select oh.name as branch_name, oh.formatted_id as branch_code, cvf.state, rh.so_code, rh.so_name, rh.rm_code, rh.rm_name, rh.ch_code, rh.ch_name, npa_classification np on np.group_id = gla.group_id left join mfi_actor.meeting_center mtc on mtc.id = gb.meeting_center_id and mtc.is_deleted = false left join mfi_actor.village_town_city vtc on
